instruction.name: xvpermi.q
instruction.description: Permute 128-bit lanes with an immediate selector.

latencies.notes: vj -> vd; consecutive unrolled copies form a chain. Raw measurement was 3.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvpermi.q $xr0, $xr8, 1; xvpermi.q $xr1, $xr9, 1; xvpermi.q $xr2, $xr10, 1; xvpermi.q $xr3, $xr11, 1; xvpermi.q $xr4, $xr12, 1; xvpermi.q $xr5, $xr13, 1; xvpermi.q $xr6, $xr14, 1; xvpermi.q $xr7, $xr15, 1
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x0102030405060708; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr1, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr2, $r4' --asm 'xvpermi.q $xr0, $xr8, 1; xvpermi.q $xr1, $xr9, 1; xvpermi.q $xr2, $xr10, 1; xvpermi.q $xr3, $xr11, 1; xvpermi.q $xr4, $xr12, 1; xvpermi.q $xr5, $xr13, 1; xvpermi.q $xr6, $xr14, 1; xvpermi.q $xr7, $xr15, 1'

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
